title: Kadison–Kastler Conjecture for Separable $C^*$-Algebras
exact_target: For a separable Hilbert space $H$, does there exist $\delta>0$ such that every pair of separable $C^*$-algebras $A,B\subset B(H)$ with $d(A,B)<\delta$ are spatially isomorphic?
